profile.headline: Senior Full Stack Engineer | .NET & Azure | Enterprise Platforms, System Modernization, Cloud Architecture
profile.summary:
I’m a senior software engineer who enjoys building systems that make complicated business processes simpler and more reliable.

I’ve worked across the full stack using C#, .NET, and Azure to design and deliver enterprise platforms, internal workflow tools, and customer-facing web applications. A big part of my work has been modernizing legacy systems and turning spreadsheet-driven processes into scalable software that teams actually enjoy using.

I like roles where I can stay hands-on while also contributing to architecture, mentoring engineers, and helping shape technical direction.

Currently open to opportunities focused on platform development, cloud systems, and complex business applications.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Collaborate with a tight-knit agile (kanban) team in order to deliver high quality and functional software and support for the Public Websites in order to facilitate marketing in their goal of increasing lead generation and ultimately student enrollment
- Migration of 30+ K-12 school websites and content from the Sitefinity content management system to DNN (DotNetNuke) including dozens of custom-built user controls, various microservices, and extensive refactoring of legacy code
- Principal developer/architect on a custom redirection service that improved site reliability and improved page load speeds sitewide by over 50%
- Principal developer on a performance optimization initiative that further improved page load speeds and increased Google PageRank score by over 100%
- Initiated and oversaw the creation of an automated testing framework that allows less experienced automation engineers code more rapidly and efficiently
- Migration and improvement of legacy lead capture forms in an effort to increase student enrollment
- Provide guidance and mentoring to lower level Software/Automation Engineers and Quality Control Analysts in the areas of SOLID principles, design patterns, and clean code
- Interaction with product stakeholders primarily in the marketing department to gather requirements/feedback in addition to the direct support of our software
- Integration of various third party APIs/frameworks and services within our DNN ecosystem
- Analyze and improve the performance of crucial components of our consumer-facing websites

positions.title: Software Engineer I
Software Engineer/Tech Support
positions.description:
-Sole developer of internal proprietary CMS, workflow, inventory, and billing systems (ASP.NET, VB.NET, JQuery, JavaScript)
-Developing and maintaining client websites and custom features
-Graphic Design
-SQL Database design and maintenance
-Met with clients for requirements gathering and designing new features to solve business problems
-Research and Development of new document imaging technologies
-Tech support
-Maintaining company computers and network
